title: VERTICES PARTNERS acts on Open Secret fundraise
description: Immaculatebites Private Limited, dba Open Secret, has raised ₹50 crore from a fundraise led by Desai Brothers Group. VERTICES PARTNERS advised Open Secret on this fundraise.The transaction was led by Vishal Mehta (Partner), along with Nisha Dharod (Associate Manager).
